The '''''Omega Gaila''''' was a cargo transport ship. The ship was used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to transport containers of ammunition from the [[Regional Naval Supply Area]] near [[Gall/Legends|Gall]], to the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star I]] while it was under construction at [[Despayre]].

One particular shipment contained a cargo of high-explosives that had been rigged to detonate onboard the Death Star by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] agents. However, this shipment was diverted to the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Undauntable]]'', which was destroyed instead.
